title: All-hands Nov 2026 - talking points & Q&A (draft)
content:
Purpose: rough draft of the Nov 2026 all-hands announcement + CEO/exec talking points and a Q&A bank. Still shaping cadence and timing.

High-level ask: finalize slide deck by 2026-10-20; confirm CEO and product talking points by 10/18; collect any team-level 1-slide updates by 10/16.

Proposed headline for announcement email (short):
- All-hands: State of Redwood — Nov 2026 (Wed Nov 3, 10:00am PT)

Proposed long subject (internal calendar + email):
- Redwood All-Hands — Wed Nov 3 • 10:00am PT • CEO + Product update + Q&A

Run of show (45-60 min):
- 0:00 - 0:05 Welcome + housekeeping (Harper)
- 0:05 - 0:20 CEO update: macro strategy, wins since last all-hands, focus areas
- 0:20 - 0:35 Product update (Samira): hosted API metrics, Dedicated/Private traction, Optimize toolkit progress
- 0:35 - 0:45 Ops & hiring (Priya / Lucas): SRE status, hiring priorities, support improvements
- 0:45 - 1:00 Live Q&A (moderated) + closing

Main CEO talking points (draft):
- Quick opener: thanks for everything this quarter — shipped hard features and kept SLAs tight.
- Metrics highlight: overall API latency P50 down 8% vs last quarter; Dedicated utilization up 22% month-over-month (internal metrics - put numbers in slides).
- Customer momentum: 3 new mid-market Dedicated contracts signed (anonymized) and one private pilot in finance.
- Product thesis reminder: serving > owning — remind folks why speed, cost, and reliability are core.
- Strategic asks: continue focus on reliability, observable regressions early, model/regression testing in PRs.
- Near-term bets: Improve auto-batching heuristics, rollout quantization profiles for smaller models, and ship the new rollout UI in console.
- Close: appreciation note + what success looks like next quarter (cut cost-per-token by 10% on non-hosted workloads; 99.9% availability target for Dedicated).

Product update (Samira draft):
- Hosted API: usage growth +20% q/q; new streaming improvements landed in beta — early feedback good but need perf tuning.
- Dedicated: two enterprise pilots moved to staging; issues: one customer reported cold-start latency spike — brief root cause note and remediation plan (pre-warm nodes + cache priming).
- Private: initial on-prem deployment checklist updated; certification work in progress for SOC2+PCI (timeline slide).
- Optimize: internal evals show ~12% avg token-cost saving under recommended batching configs; still tuning outliers.

Ops & hiring (Priya/Lucas):
- SRE: incident review (Oct 2) — summary: transient region outage, failover worked but alerting thresholds delayed on-call. Action: change alert policy and run a playbook drill next sprint.
- Hiring: top priorities: infra engineer (serving runtime), product manager (Console & Rollouts), senior SRE. Current pipeline: 8 onsite candidates this month.

Q&A bank (anticipated questions + suggested answers):
- Q: Any update on pricing changes?
  A: No public pricing changes right now. We are experimenting with new batching/quantization opt recommendations as product features — impacts will be communicated when GA-ready.

- Q: How are we approaching model regressions and evals?
  A: Centralizing regression alerts tied to prompt suites in Redwood Optimize; team-level ownership for alert triage; program to add regression checks in deploy pipelines.

- Q: Status of Private deployments for regulated customers?
  A: Private roadmap on track: VPC option GA in Q1 2027; on-prem pilot ongoing with 1 customer. Compliance work is on the critical path.

- Q: Are we pausing any hires given market conditions?
  A: We are prioritizing hires that unblock product & reliability; not pausing but being selective.

- Q: What metrics should ICs care about next quarter?
  A: Two we care about company-wide: availability (SLA %) and cost-per-token for non-hosted workloads. Team-level metrics will be shared after leadership sync.

Notes to self / unresolved:
- Confirm CEO availability + backfill speaker notes by 10/18. (TODO: get example KPIs for slides from analytics - ask Lucas.)
- Need a short anonymized customer quote for the product slide — ask CS.
- Decide whether to include a 5-min live demo (pros: tangible wins; cons: risk of demo flake). Lean: skip live demo unless dry run on 10/25 passes.
- Moderator for Q&A: confirm Samira or Lucas.

Email announcement draft (short):
- Hi folks,

  Please join us for the Redwood All-Hands on Wed Nov 3 at 10:00am PT. Harper, Samira, and leaders from Product & Ops will share updates on product milestones, reliability work, and hiring priorities, followed by live Q&A.

  Add to calendar: (link)

  If you have questions in advance, drop them in #all-hands-questions or DM me.

  — Harper

Timing + next steps:
- 10/14: finalize run of show + speakers (this doc)
- 10/16: team slides due (1 slide each)
- 10/18: leadership review of slides
- 10/20: final deck locked and email calendar invite sent

Slack/PR links to include in final doc: #all-hands-ops, #announcements, ENG-4921 (slide tracking).

TODOS (quick):
- [ ] Ask CS for customer quote (Priya)
- [ ] Get analytics KPIs (Lucas)
- [ ] CEO speaker notes draft (Harper)
- [ ] Confirm moderator and dry-run time

Scratchpad/brainstorm lines (keep):
- Consider 2–3 highlight stats on one slide (latency, Dedicated utilization, bookings) + 1 customer quote + 1 roadmap bullet.
- Keep Q&A open format but collect top 5 questions from Slack beforehand to seed discussion.

End of draft.

(If anything missing or you want to reword someone's line, mark with [edit] and I'll iterate.)
